component.name: RowListGuide
component.script:
Sub init() m.Poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.Label = m.top.findNode("label") m.Label2 = m.top.findNode("label2")
m.Label2.font.size = "20" End Sub
Sub itemContentChanged() m.Poster.uri = m.top.itemContent.HDPosterUrl m.Label.text = m.top.itemContent.title starttime= m.top.itemContent.ShortDescriptionLine2 endtime=m.top.itemContent.description starttimes=Mid (starttime, 1, 19) endtimes=Mid (endtime, 1, 19) dtstart = timeConvertstart (starttimes) dtend = timeConvertend(endtimes) m.Label2.text=dtstart+" "+"-"+dtend updateLayout() End Sub
Sub updateLayout() if m.top.height > 0 and m.top.width > 0 m.Poster.width = "400" m.Poster.height = "300" m.Label.translation = [0, 210] m.Label.width = m.Poster.width m.Label.color="##10c1d0" m.Label2.translation = [25, m.Poster.height + 10] end if End Sub
Function timeConvertstart (estString As String) As Object ' An roDateTime by default gives current time in UTC dt = CreateObject ("roDateTime") ' Set the time from the EST string input dt.FromISO8601String (estString) dt.ToLocalTime () chour=dt.GetHours() cminute=dt.GetMinutes() IF chour=0 chour=12 ampm="AM" ELSE If chour=12 chour=12 ampm="PM" Else If chour>12 chour= chour-12 ampm="PM" Else If chour<12 chour=chour ampm="AM" ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF if dt.getMinutes() <10 cminute="0"+str(dt.getMinutes()).Trim() else cminute=str(dt.getMinutes()).Trim() end if ctime=str(chour)+":"+cminute+" "+ampm ' Return the local time representation of the EST input Return ctime End Function
Function timeConvertend (estString As String) As Object ' An roDateTime by default gives current time in UTC dt = CreateObject ("roDateTime") ' Set the time from the EST string input dt.FromISO8601String (estString) ' Convert to local time dt.ToLocalTime () ' Return the local time representation of the EST input chour=dt.GetHours() cminute=dt.GetMinutes() IF chour=0 chour=12 ampm="AM" ELSE If chour=12 chour=12 ampm="PM" Else If chour>12 chour= chour-12 ampm="PM" Else If chour<12 chour=chour ampm="AM" ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF ENDIF if dt.getMinutes() <10 cminute="0"+str(dt.getMinutes()).Trim() else cminute=str(dt.getMinutes()).Trim() end if ctime=str(chour)+":"+cminute+" " +ampm ' Return the local time representation of the EST input Return ctime End Function
